The Dockerfile build fails during the 'apt install' step with errors: 'E: Unable to locate package python3.11', 'Unable to locate package python3.11-venv', and 'Unable to locate package python3.11-distutils'. This indicates that the Ubuntu 20.04 base image repository does not contain Python 3.11 packages by default. To fix this, you should add the deadsnakes PPA or another appropriate PPA to the sources list before installing Python 3.11 and related packages. For example, run: 'apt update && apt install -y software-properties-common && add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa && apt update && apt install -y python3.11 python3.11-venv python3.11-distutils python3-pip' etc. This will provide access to Python 3.11 packages on Ubuntu 20.04. Without this fix, the environment cannot be set up correctly, so tests cannot be executed. Original error message snippet: 
E: Unable to locate package python3.11
E: Unable to locate package python3.11-venv
E: Unable to locate package python3.11-distutils
